decisions.reason: As a finish-led extension of the core drainage range, it draws almost entirely on existing manufacturing, design and channel knowledge, so the firm can keep it with only limited fashion-risk.
This shower channel remains very close to the firm's established technical base and customer needs, making continued refinement and retention the low-risk choice.
The tileable floor drain fits the firm's strong know-how in barrier-free bathroom drainage and its installer-planner ecosystem, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The stainless steel design grate is a closely related portfolio element that leverages the firm's design-engineering capabilities, with only modest risk of line pruning.

Although the pump-drain channel benefits from learning and in-house R&D after the earlier withdrawal of Product C, pump-based solutions are still somewhat less aligned with the firm's core passive-drainage competence and therefore carry the highest withdrawal risk.
